correctness.rationale: For C10^2 with 20 edges, exact enumeration of perfect matchings yields 22 five-edge facets and 457 nonempty faces, with face counts (20,115,190,110,22); ordinary matching complex has additional nonextendible faces and is not interchangeable. An independently implemented lexicographic edge-mask discrete Morse matching leaves one 0-cell, one 1-cell and seven 2-cells (224 matched pairs); oriented Hasse DAG contains all 457 nodes and is acyclic. Independent integer gradient expansion yields the precise 2-to-1 Morse boundary (-1,-1,0,0,-1,0,0), containing a primitive unit attachment. The one-cell with one 2-cell cancels, proving integral wedge of six 2-spheres and nonshellability in a pure four-dimensional complex. Independent signed Lefschetz enumeration of all 20 dihedral symmetries gives rotations (6,-1,1,-1,1,4,1,-1,1,-1) and reflections (2,0,2,0,2,0,2,0,2,0); average 1, matching rational D10 fixed-rank one. These computations exhaust a single ten-vertex complex, not all antiprisms.
